blocks.text: Negros Occidental is pinning its hopes for a Miss Universe Philippines victory on Filipino-Japanese singer-actress Yuki Sonoda, and is fielding the international pageant veteran to the 2027 national competition. Sonoda was formally crowned as Miss Universe Philippines Negros Occidental by the Miss Universe Philippines Negros Island Organization on Saturday evening, Oct. 3. But while Sonoda is taking her shot at the chance to represent the Philippines on the international stage, her previous global pageant experience saw her carrying her father’s home country, Japan.
